notes.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic+ is now available on Apple Arcade!
notes.notes:
RCT Classic+ on [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rollercoaster-tycoon-classic/id6702028686]Apple Arcade[/url] includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon PC Games, now enhanced for handheld devices.

The three expansion packs: Wacky Worlds, Time Twister and Toolkit are all included in this Apple Arcade version.

If you prefer the desktop experience, we’ve got great news for you too. RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic on Steam is updated for the latest versions of macOS!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/683900/RollerCoaster_Tycoon_Classic/

notes.title: Randomizer mod for RollerCoaster Tycoon breathes life into a bonafide classic
notes.notes: To my profound horror, there are probably people reading this article who haven't been around as long as RollerCoaster Tycoon, the classic theme park management sim from 1999. In the decades it's been with us, every square inch of RollerCoaster Tycoon has been picked apart and mastered. There's nothing left to discover and no surprises in store. RollerCoaster Tycoon is a solved game. Or it was, anyway... Read more.

notes.title: Additional European Languages for RollerCoaster Tycoon: Deluxe Now Live!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that we have added French, Italian, German, and Spanish translations for RollerCoaster Tycoon: Deluxe to Steam! These additional languages are available for FREE to all who own the game through Steam. By buying the game once on Steam you get access to all 5 languages and without any added cost. 

For most players, Steam will automatically recognize what language your Steam Client is set to and adjust the game's language to that, if it is available. However, if you notice that the game's language has not changed automatically, you can manually change it by going to your Game Library in Steam > Opening the Game Properties > Clicking Languages > and Setting the Language of your Choice. The game will then re-download in that language. 

Please note, although we have tested this extensively and did not see any issues with Saved Games, you should as a precaution backup your Saved Game before switching.

Saved games can be found at the following location on your computer:

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\RollerCoaster Tycoon Deluxe\Saved Games

Enjoy,
The RCT Team

notes.title: Recent RollerCoaster Tycoon: Deluxe Update Info
notes.notes:
Dear RCT Fans:

As you know, the entire [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?snr=1_5_9__12&term=rollercoaster+#term=rollercoaster%20&genre=Simulation&publisher=Atari&sort_order=ASC&page=1]RollerCoaster Tycoon® PC catalog is available on Steam[/url] and we want to share some updates.
[list]

[*]First, we released a small update for RollerCoaster Tycoon® Deluxe on 5/28/14 to increase compatibility with new Operating Systems (Win 7 and 8).  One side effect we have seen is the update may erase your saved games.  However, there is a solution to get your saved progress back.  After you have already updated the game, you need to rename the file CSS0.DAT  to OLD_CSSO.DAT.  This file can be found at this path: \Steam\steamapps\common\RollerCoaster Tycoon Deluxe\Data 

[*]Second, new players who downloaded the game after 5/28/14 are unaffected.

[*]Third, we are working on fully compatible FIGS versions of the game that we plan to give to all players for FREE!  Please make sure to back-up your saved games because changing languages will overwrite your saved game.  
[/list]
[*]The Saved Games folder is located in your Steam installation folder: 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\RollerCoaster Tycoon Deluxe\Saved Games.  

[*]After you back up the entire Saved Games folder, copy the contents back in once you are done with the update.   

Now relive the entire franchise from its beginnings! Experience the excitement of building and running incredible parks filled with the most outrageous thrill rides imaginable. Once you start playing, you won’t want to stop!
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/285310]
Click Here[/url]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - RollerCoaster Tycoon® 1 and 2
notes.notes:
RollerCoaster Tycoon®: Deluxe and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2: Triple Thrill Pack are Now Available on Steam!

RollerCoaster Tycoon Deluxe takes you for a ride in the original RollerCoaster Tycoon and its expansion packs, Corkscrew Follies and Loopy Landscapes. Create the ultimate theme park using a variety of coaster types with giant loops and barrel rolls and in-park attractions like suspended monorails and water-soaked plume rides. Selectable themes for your park include Ice World, Medieval, and Martian. You'll need more than just rides and decoration to keep your guests happy, so find out what they are thinking and meet their needs to make your profits soar.

The Triple Thrill Pack compilation includes the entire RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 series, with the original game as well as the Time Twister and Wacky Worlds expansions.
